ja: 来週の引っ越し、運ぶ家具が多いから、友達にもう何人か手伝いを頼んでおくね。
en: We have a lot of furniture to move next week, so I'll ask a few more friends to help.
alternatives: Since there's a lot of furniture to move next week, I'll ask a few more friends to help out.
We've got a lot of furniture to move next week, so I'll get a few more friends to help.
point: furniture は数えられないので furnitures にしない

ja: 先週は日程が決まらなかったけど、もう全員の都合がつく日が見つかったよ。
en: We couldn't settle on a date last week, but we've found a day that works for everyone now.
alternatives: We didn't manage to pick a date last week, but we've now found one that suits everyone.
Last week we couldn't agree on a date, but we've found a day that works for everyone now.
point: 先週は過去形、「もう見つかった」は現在完了で分ける

ja: 兄に夕食に誘われたとき、私はもう別の予定を入れてしまっていた。
en: When my brother invited me to dinner, I'd already made other plans.
alternatives: I had already made other plans when my brother invited me to dinner.
By the time my brother asked me to dinner, I'd already made other plans.
point: 誘われた時点より前の予定は had made の過去完了

ja: 弟はもう一週間ずっと、みんなで行くキャンプの計画を立ててるんだ。
en: My brother has been planning our group camping trip for a week now.
alternatives: My brother's been planning the camping trip for all of us for a whole week.
For a week now, my brother has been planning the camping trip we're all going on.
point: 今も続く行動は has been planning、for で期間を示す

ja: 姉と私、旅行の日程をもう三回も変えてるんだよね。
en: My sister and I have already changed our trip dates three times.
alternatives: My sister and I have rescheduled our trip three times already.
My sister and I have already moved the dates of our trip three times.
point: 「もう三回も変えてる」は過去形でなく現在完了で言う

ja: 父は来月の連休に、大学時代の友人たちと会うことになってるんだ。
en: My dad is meeting his old college friends over the long weekend next month.
alternatives: My dad is going to meet his college friends over next month's long weekend.
My dad is getting together with his college friends over the long weekend next month.
point: 決まっている予定は現在進行形 is meeting で言える

ja: 土曜のバーベキュー、私たち何時に集合することになったんだっけ？
en: What time did we decide to meet for Saturday's barbecue?
alternatives: What time did we agree to meet for Saturday's barbecue?
When did we decide to meet for the barbecue on Saturday?
point: What time を文頭に置き、後ろは did we decide の疑問文の語順

ja: あのとき飛行機を予約しておけば、今ごろ私たちは沖縄のビーチでのんびりしているのにね。
en: If we'd booked the flight back then, we'd be relaxing on a beach in Okinawa right now.
alternatives: If we had booked that flight, we'd be on a beach in Okinawa now.
If we'd booked the flight when we had the chance, we'd be lounging on a beach in Okinawa right now.
point: 過去の条件と今の結果は if 節が過去完了、主節が would be

ja: 日曜日にみんなで映画を見に行こうよ。
en: Let's go to a movie on Sunday.
alternatives: Let's see a movie on Sunday.
Let's all go to the movies on Sunday.
point: 曜日の前は on。「日曜日に」を on Sunday とする

ja: 都合が悪いのは週末全部じゃなくて、日曜の朝だけなんだ。
en: It's only Sunday morning that doesn't work for me, not the whole weekend.
alternatives: What doesn't work for me is just Sunday morning, not the whole weekend.
It's just Sunday morning that's bad for me, not the whole weekend.
point: 強調したい「日曜の朝」を It's と that で挟む

ja: もし私に車があったら、今週末あなたを空港まで送っていけるんだけどね。
en: If I had a car, I could drive you to the airport this weekend.
alternatives: I'd drive you to the airport this weekend if I had a car.
If I had a car, I'd be able to take you to the airport this weekend.
point: 事実と違う仮定は had、帰結は could を使う

ja: 母が、日曜の夕食会は6時からに変更になったって言ってたよ。
en: My mom said Sunday's dinner had been moved to six o'clock.
alternatives: My mom said the Sunday dinner had been changed to six.
Mom told me Sunday's dinner had been moved to six.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去へ（had been moved）

ja: 最近残業続きだから、金曜の飲み会は行くのをやめておこうと思ってるんだ。
en: I've been working late a lot lately, so I'm thinking of skipping Friday's drinks.
alternatives: I've been working overtime a lot recently, so I'm thinking about skipping the drinks on Friday.
Since I've been working late so much lately, I'm thinking of not going to Friday's drinks.
point: think of の後は -ing 形。to skip にしない

ja: ごめん、疲れてるからパーティーに行けないよ。
en: Sorry, I can't go to the party. I'm tired.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm too tired to go to the party.
Sorry, I can't come to the party. I'm tired.
point: 「行けない」は can't go、理由は短く別の文で足せる

ja: ケンに、日曜のハイキングは何時に出発するのか聞いてもらえる？
en: Could you ask Ken what time we're leaving for the hike on Sunday?
alternatives: Can you ask Ken what time we're heading out for Sunday's hike?
Could you check with Ken what time we're leaving for the hike on Sunday?
point: what time の後は we're leaving の語順で、疑問文の語順にしない

ja: 今週末は雨の予報だから、キャンプは来月に延期するのはどう？
en: The forecast says rain this weekend, so how about putting off the camping trip until next month?
alternatives: It's supposed to rain this weekend, so how about postponing the camping trip until next month?
Since rain is forecast this weekend, how about putting the camping trip off until next month?
point: how about の後は動詞の -ing 形（putting off）

ja: 姉が、君が来月の旅行の日程をもう決めたかどうか知りたがってるよ。
en: My sister wants to know whether you've decided on the dates for next month's trip yet.
alternatives: My sister's asking if you've settled on the dates for next month's trip yet.
My sister wants to know if you've picked the dates for next month's trip yet.
point: whether の後は you've decided の平叙文の語順にする

ja: 幹事に頼んで、来週の同窓会の開始を一時間遅らせてもらったよ。
en: I got the organizer to push the start of next week's reunion back an hour.
alternatives: I had the organizer push back the start of next week's reunion by an hour.
I asked the organizer to move next week's reunion an hour later, and they did.
point: get 人 to do と have 人 do、to の有無に注意

ja: 兄は、父が退院する日がわかるまで、帰省の日程は決められないって言ってる。
en: My brother says he can't decide when to come home until he knows the day Dad gets out of the hospital.
alternatives: My brother says he can't set a date to come home until he finds out when Dad's leaving the hospital.
My brother says he can't plan his trip home until he knows what day Dad will be discharged.
point: until 節の中は未来のことでも現在形（knows）

ja: キャンセルするなら、せめて前の日に教えてくれればよかったのに。
en: If you were going to cancel, you should have at least told me the day before.
alternatives: You could have at least let me know the day before if you were going to cancel.
If you had to cancel, you should have at least told me a day earlier.
point: 「〜すればよかったのに」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: 日曜のピクニックは雨のせいで来週に延期されたよ。
en: Sunday's picnic has been postponed until next week because of the rain.
alternatives: Sunday's picnic was put off until next week because of the rain.
Because of the rain, Sunday's picnic has been pushed back to next week.
point: ピクニックが主語なので has been postponed の受け身

ja: 悪いけど、今週末に僕が本当に必要なのは、家でのんびりする時間なんだ。
en: Sorry, but what I really need this weekend is some time to relax at home.
alternatives: Sorry, but what I really need this weekend is some downtime at home.
Sorry, but this weekend what I really need is time to just relax at home.
point: 「〜なのは」は What I need is で始める

ja: 兄は毎週土曜日の午前中、サッカーの練習があるよ。
en: My brother has soccer practice every Saturday morning.
alternatives: My brother goes to soccer practice every Saturday morning.
My older brother has soccer practice on Saturday mornings.
point: 主語が三人称単数なので have ではなく has

ja: 姉が金曜に電話してきて、土曜の夕食には行けないって言ってたよ。
en: My sister called me on Friday and said she couldn't make it to dinner on Saturday.
alternatives: My sister called me on Friday and said she couldn't come to dinner on Saturday.
My sister phoned me on Friday to say she couldn't make it to Saturday's dinner.
point: 過去の発言なので can't ではなく couldn't に時制をそろえる

ja: サラから電話があったとき、私たちはちょうど週末の予定を話し合っていた。
en: We were just talking about our weekend plans when Sarah called.
alternatives: We were just discussing our plans for the weekend when Sarah called.
When Sarah called, we were just talking about our plans for the weekend.
point: 話していた最中は過去進行形、電話は過去形 called

ja: お母さん、土曜の夕食に友達を二人連れて行ってもいいかな？
en: Mom, is it okay if I bring two friends along to dinner on Saturday?
alternatives: Mom, would it be okay if I brought two friends to dinner on Saturday?
Mom, can I bring two friends along to Saturday's dinner?
point: 相手のいる場所へ「連れて行く」は take でなく bring

ja: 急で悪いんだけど、土曜のランチを日曜にずらせないかなと思ってて。
en: Sorry for the short notice, but I was wondering if we could move Saturday's lunch to Sunday instead.
alternatives: Sorry it's so last minute, but would it be possible for us to move Saturday's lunch to Sunday?
Sorry for the late notice, but I was hoping we could push Saturday's lunch back to Sunday.
point: 柔らかい頼み方は I was wondering if we could

ja: 土曜の朝、駅の近くにできた新しいカフェで会おうよ。
en: Let's meet at the new café near the station on Saturday morning.
alternatives: How about meeting at the new café by the station on Saturday morning?
Why don't we meet at the new café near the station Saturday morning?
point: 「駅の近くの」は near the station を名詞の後ろに置く
